texts: mixed: the collectors-dry-feathers rule fires and the sky-cat origin is recorded, but "the feathers" reads as one particular batch, so the parse ends up saying every collector dries that same shared set rather than sky-cat feathers in general. Rewrite as "Collectors dry sky-cat feathers." — dropping the definite article makes the object a kind rather than a specific batch, and "sky-cat" still unpacks to cat, so no content is lost.

mixed: everything of substance is right — the protecting event, the lantern as the thing protected, the group of ground feathers with its genus, and the roughly-one-month duration — but the vague quantity was recorded as "handful" rather than the exact wording our quantity lexicon lists, so the amount may not resolve to a number downstream. Nothing in your sentence caused that and no rewrite is strictly needed; if you want to be safe, "Several ground feathers protect a lantern for about a month." uses a quantity word the lexicon demonstrably handles and keeps the same vague small count.
